messages:
deploy-bot: preflight check FAILED for release/2026-03-20-canary
- reason: env parity mismatch detected between staging and prod
- diffs:
  * INFER_MODEL_PIN -> PROD: "redwood-v2-prod" vs STAGING: "infer_model_pin=redwood-v2-canary" (case/format mismatch)
  * KVCACHE_PREFIX -> PROD: "kv-cache" vs STAGING: "kv_cache"
  * KEY_PATH casing: PROD uses "/keystore/Inference", staging has "/keystore/inference"
- action: release blocked by default policy (env-parity-guard)

deploy-bot: To proceed, resolve parity or request manual override: `/release allow-parity-override --reason`

alice: holding release. this smells like a normalization change in the model-pin PR.

ben: which services will 404 or fail?

alice: inference-router will fail lookup for KV keys, cache-layer TTL mismatch might drop hits, and rollout could fail on keystore lookup.

carol: ack. no prod push until fixed. options: revert the renaming PR, or patch staging to match prod and re-run preflight. reverting is safer if prod already relies on the new key format.

devops-sre: i can patch staging configmap quickly to match prod keys and re-run deploy-bot preflight. note: if this was intentional rename we should coordinate a proper migration.

alice: change came from PR #4521 (model pin rename). @ben can you check whether that PR intended the key rename or if it was accidental?

ben: checking PR now. yes, I changed the key in the helm chart to use snake_case for consistency, but looks like we missed canonicalization in the router. i can revert the helm change and open a revert PR. ETA ~12m.

carol: if revert will be ready ~12m, patching staging would be riskier (drift). i'd prefer revert so prod remains source of truth. @deploy-bot once PR merged, re-run preflight pls.

ben: creating revert PR -> #4530. running CI.

marta: heads up to docs/release-notes: this will affect model pinning behavior if the rename goes through. we'll add a note about normalizing env var keys in next release notes.

devops-sre: once revert PR lands, i'll kick off preflight and smoke test on canary. command i'll run:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/inference-router
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o wide
```

carol: thanks. keep this thread updated. if something blocks revert, we'll fallback to patching staging and scheduling a migration plan. :hourglass: :warning:

deploy-bot: release paused (policy: env-parity-guard). awaiting preflight-success or manual override.

alice: noted. adding checklist: 1) revert PR merged 2) deploy-bot green 3) smoke on canary 4) prod promotion window open.

ben: PR #4530 merged and CI passed. tagging @devops-sre to re-run preflight.

devops-sre: preflight re-run in progress...

deploy-bot: preflight SUCCESS. no env diffs detected. release can proceed per window.

carol: proceeding with scheduled promotion in 20m. thanks team.

marta: will update release notes & changelog after promotion completes.
